cues.text: Peddy, wake up! Today is our big picnic day!
Five more minutes… wait, picnic?
I'm up!
Sandwiches, juice, cake… we pack everything!
And cookies. Lots of cookies. A mountain of cookies!
Okay, okay, cookies too. Let's go raid the kitchen!
Picnic, picnic, picnic!
Good morning, my little picnic monsters!
Good morning, Mom! We need food. All the food.
The normal sandwiches are on the table. Take those.
Mom, what is this green sandwich glowing in here?
Don't touch that! It's Grandpa's magic sandwich!
Magic? What does it do?
Nobody knows. Grandpa ate one and croaked all week!
Croaked? Like a frog?
Like a very loud frog. So leave it alone, okay?
I'm going to water the plants. Be good!
Just one tiny bite later… for science.
Peddy, no! That is a terrible idea.
Relax! I'll only look at it. Promise.
Okay, basket is full. Juice, cake, normal sandwiches.
Shh! Is Mom watching?
Why are you hiding behind the sofa?
No reason! Totally normal hiding.
You took the green sandwich, didn't you?
Maybe. A little. It's in the basket.
If you turn into a frog, I'm not carrying you!
This basket is heavier than me!
Walk faster before Mom sees us!
Woof! I smell something magic!
Nice doggy… go away, doggy!
Hmm, green bread? No thanks, I like bones.
Even the dog is scared of it!
That's not funny. That's a warning!
Look at this place! Trees, birds, and a pond!
Finally! My arms are noodles now.
Mmm! Normal sandwich number one, done!
Ahh, cold juice. This is the best day ever!
Now… for dessert.
The glowing one!
Peddy, Mom said NO!
Just one bite. What could go wrong?
Everything! Everything could go wrong!
Too late!
Crunch!
Teddy… why is everything so… big?
PEDDY!
Ribbit?! Why is my voice so croaky?
You are a FROG! A green, jumpy frog!
I don't want to eat flies forever!
Don't panic. Think, Teddy, think!
I can't stop jumping! Boing! Boing!
Sorry… sorry, it's a little bit funny.
It is NOT funny! Ribbit!
Ooh, a juicy little frog for my breakfast!
Teddy, help! The cat wants to eat me!
Shoo, cat! That frog is my best friend!
Fine, fine! Nobody shares anything anymore.
Thank you, Teddy. Now how do I turn back?
Maybe the pond knows! Frogs love ponds!
Hello! Why is that little frog crying?
She ate a magic sandwich. Can you help us?
Easy! Magic washes off in water. Jump in!
Here I go!
Still a frog! Still croaky! Ribbit!
Oh, pond water is too lazy. You need waterfall water!
A waterfall? Where do we find one?
Past the farm, through the forest, over the bridge.
That sounds very far for tiny frog legs.
Don't worry. I'll show you the way. Quack!
Mooo! Who is stepping on my grass?
Sorry, Mrs. Cow! We're looking for the waterfall.
The waterfall? Why does a boy need a waterfall?
Not him. Me! I'm a frog by accident!
By accident? Let me guess. The green sandwich?
How did you know?!
Grandpa came here last year. Croaking. Very loud.
He jumped in my mud puddle! Twice!
Grandpa, what were you doing?
Go through the forest. Follow the river. You'll hear the waterfall.
Thank you, Mrs. Cow! Thank you, Mr. Pig!
Why am I carrying a log?
To cross the river, silly!
Oh wait, there is a bridge.
Frogs are smarter than boys today!
Okay, smarty frog, hop on!
Hey! Nobody passes without paying!
Paying? We only have… sandwiches.
Sandwiches?
Okay, one sandwich, you may pass.
Give him the normal one, Teddy! Not the green one!
Here. A normal one, I promise.
Delicious! The waterfall is right ahead!
See? Almost there! Keep going!
Look! The waterfall! It's sparkling!
Told you! Now jump in, little frog!
What if it's too cold? What if I sink?
You can do it. Frogs are great swimmers!
Wish me luck!
Peddy? Peddy! Are you okay?
I'm ME again! No more ribbits!
I was so worried about you!
Hooray! Magic washed away!
So… that sandwich really was magic.
Very magic. Never eating green bread again!
Wait… there's still half left in the basket.
Throw it away, Teddy!
But… it smells so good. Like cookies and pizza together.
TEDDY. Don't you dare!
Oops… I was hungry!
Oh no, not again!
Ribbit?!
Now YOU are the frog!
The waterfall is right there, froggy!
This is so embarrassing. Don't tell anyone!
I'm telling everyone.
Here I go!
Back to normal! Ha!
Best picnic ever!
Bye, frogs! I mean, bye, friends!
So… where is Grandpa's magic sandwich?
Sandwich? What sandwich?
We… gave it to a monkey?
You ATE it, didn't you?!
Just a little. And we turned into frogs.
But the waterfall fixed us! Good as new!
Then you two can wash all the picnic plates.
Being a frog was easier!
Ribbit!
